descriptions.text: Personal Space Upgrade. Tier 3 Doggie Door. So, you're out adventuring, and you suddenly have a hankerin' for those sweet pancakes you had two weeks back at some dive that's now over two hundred kilometers away. What are you gonna do? Travel for several hours in the wrong direction just to get another taste? Psshh. Okay, loser. The cool kids use the doggie door. Upgrades the door in your personal space to allow a selectable exit via any door you have previously utilized on this same floor, effectively creating a fast travel waypoint system. Allows shared gated access amongst guests and party members.

beats.headline: Five, from Lucia Mar
beats.text: Li Jun tells Carl how they got here: Lucia Mar. After what they are calling the Battle of Beijing, they thought she had gone down the stairs, but she was waiting for them, really friendly, which was unsettling; Florin had messaged her to help. She dropped five personal space upgrade modules on the ground and went down. One is already installed in Imani's room. It is a tier 3, Katia adds, which Mordecai says should not be available until the ninth floor. He thinks Lucia stole them when she went on a show.

beats.headline: Through Imani's door
beats.text: Carl reads the module: the cool kids use the doggie door. It lets a personal space door open onto any door its owner has already used on the floor, a fast-travel waypoint system, shared with guests and party members. With one in Imani's room, Katia says, the whole Meadowlark party can go out into the church, or into Washington or Detroit, or Belgium. Giving it to the entire guild would cost twenty-five million for a tier three, Imani says; in the meantime they have four more for single doors.

beats.headline: Our room and Katia's
beats.text: Florin, Imani and Elle are leaving the city for the headquarters, to meet the adjutant and get it ready. Once they are set up, the plan is to use the doggie door upgrade to fast travel from the city to the headquarters. In the meantime, Carl and Donut have already installed the doggie door upgrade in their room, along with Katia's.

beats.headline: Out the college door
beats.text: Carl and Donut go to Katia's personal space and, thanks to the new Doggie Door upgrade, leave by the college entrance, several rings higher, which gives them the chance to recruit along the way. Katia and Elle have been working the chats, but a recruit has to be physically touched to be officially enlisted, so people will meet them on the road.

beats.headline: A door into the castle
beats.text: Donut shouts in the chat that Bomo has noticed an extra door in the situational space, a saferoom door for the Reaver team: they are sneak attacking through it, into the castle. It hits Carl too late. Every time they left the guild saferoom for the FUPA through the bait shop, that space was a long corridor of doors from all the crawlers coming and going. Off-world sponsors can use personal spaces as well, and can buy a doggie door upgrade, so any of them who ever came in through the bait shop can come back that way. The bait shop is inside the castle now.

beats.headline: Dialled to Larracos
beats.text: With minutes to spare, the last of the group files into the saferoom behind Carl, and he quickly dials the Larracos gate on the doggie door. Dong Quixote is riding Gonk, and rather than the pet stables Carl orders him to Shanty Town, which has an exit fit for a swamp yak. The door beeps, ready. Rend goes first; the stairs are steep.
